notes: message_hash = hash_array(["StarkNet Message", domain_hash, account, struct_hash]) with hash_array = Poseidon (poseidon_hash_span).
All hex values are 0x-prefixed field elements without zero padding.
Every document under "invalid" MUST be rejected by a conforming implementation; "reason" names the rule.

vectors.name: integers
vectors.description: Every integer basic type, including negative signed values (encoded as P + v) and timestamp (u64).

vectors.name: felts-and-bool
vectors.description: felt, ContractAddress, ClassHash, bytes31 accept JSON numbers, decimal strings and 0x strings; bool is a JSON boolean.

vectors.name: strings
vectors.description: shortstring is always the ASCII bytes ("2" encodes as 0x32); string is the Cairo ByteArray serialisation of the UTF-8 bytes, hashed.

vectors.name: selector
vectors.description: selector is always starknet_keccak of the entrypoint name.

vectors.name: u256
vectors.description: u256 is a basic type encoded as two felts (low, high) inside the parent hash input; the type string is just "u256".

vectors.name: nested-structs-and-arrays
vectors.description: Struct references, arrays of structs, arrays of basic types, nested arrays and an empty array.

vectors.name: enum-empty-variant
vectors.description: Enum referenced by name; variant with no parameters hashes as [type_hash, index].

vectors.description: A single leaf is the root.

vectors.name: single-variant-enum
vectors.description: A type whose only field type is parenthesised is a one-variant enum, not a tuple; nested in a struct it is valid.

invalid.name: revision-as-number
invalid.reason: revision must be the JSON string "2"

invalid.name: revision-1-document
invalid.reason: a revision 1 document is not a revision 2 document

invalid.name: domain-extra-field
invalid.reason: domain object has a field the domain type does not declare

invalid.name: domain-chain_id-key
invalid.reason: legacy chain_id key

invalid.name: domain-fields-reordered
invalid.reason: domain type fields must be in the specified order

invalid.name: domain-optional-out-of-order
invalid.reason: salt must come after verifyingContract

invalid.name: primary-type-is-domain
invalid.reason: primaryType cannot be StarknetDomain

invalid.name: unknown-type
invalid.reason: field type is neither basic nor declared

invalid.name: dangling-type
invalid.reason: declared type not reachable from primaryType

invalid.name: recursive-type
invalid.reason: recursive type definitions are not allowed

invalid.name: message-undeclared-field
invalid.reason: message has a field the type does not declare

invalid.name: message-missing-field
invalid.reason: message lacks a declared field

invalid.name: u8-out-of-range
invalid.reason: value exceeds the type range

invalid.name: u64-negative
invalid.reason: unsigned type given a negative value

invalid.name: i8-out-of-range
invalid.reason: signed value below the type range

invalid.name: felt-at-prime
invalid.reason: felt must be below the field prime

invalid.name: address-above-bound
invalid.reason: ContractAddress must be below 2^251

invalid.name: selector-hex
invalid.reason: selector values must be entrypoint names, never hashes

invalid.name: selector-invalid-identifier
invalid.reason: selector must be a Cairo identifier

invalid.name: shortstring-too-long
invalid.reason: shortstring longer than 31 bytes

invalid.name: shortstring-non-ascii
invalid.reason: shortstring must be printable ASCII

invalid.name: shortstring-as-number
invalid.reason: shortstring values must be JSON strings

invalid.name: bool-as-string
invalid.reason: bool must be a JSON boolean

invalid.name: reserved-type-name
invalid.reason: user types cannot use a basic type name

invalid.name: tuple-as-primary-type
invalid.reason: an all-parenthesised type is an enum, and primaryType must be a struct

invalid.name: tuple-next-to-struct-field
invalid.reason: a type mixes struct fields and enum variants

invalid.name: enum-as-primary-type
invalid.reason: primaryType must be a struct

invalid.name: contains-on-non-merkletree
invalid.reason: "contains" is only allowed on merkletree fields

invalid.name: duplicate-field-name
invalid.reason: field names within a type must be unique

invalid.reason: names cannot contain the double quote character

invalid.name: name-with-colon
invalid.reason: names cannot contain the colon character

invalid.name: name-trailing-space
invalid.reason: names cannot start or end with whitespace

invalid.name: type-name-with-star
invalid.reason: type names cannot end with *

invalid.name: enum-two-keys
invalid.reason: an enum value has exactly one variant key

invalid.name: enum-unknown-variant
invalid.reason: variant not declared

invalid.name: enum-param-count
invalid.reason: variant parameters must match the declaration

invalid.name: enum-with-contains

invalid.name: merkletree-missing-contains
invalid.reason: merkletree fields must name their leaf type

invalid.reason: a merkletree must have at least one leaf

invalid.name: merkletree-basic-leaf
